sn22.84:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā tisso bhagavato pitucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti
sn22.84:1.3: api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo disāpi me na pakkhāyanti dhammāpi maṃ nappaṭibhanti thīnamiddhañca me cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati anabhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carāmi hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchāti.
sn22.84:2.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.84:2.2: āyasmā bhante tisso bhagavato pitucchāputto sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamāroceti
sn22.84:2.3: api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo disāpi me na pakkhāyanti dhammāpi maṃ nappaṭibhanti thīnamiddhañca me cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati anabhirato ca brahmacariyaṃ carāmi hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchāti.
sn22.84:3.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn22.84:3.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu mama vacanena tissaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi satthā taṃ āvuso tissa āmantetīti.
sn22.84:3.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yenāyasmā tisso tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ tissaṃ etadavoca
sn22.84:3.5: evaṃ āvusoti kho āyasmā tisso tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ tissaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
sn22.84:3.6: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ tissa sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evamārocesi
sn22.84:3.7: api me āvuso madhurakajāto viya kāyo …pe… hoti ca me dhammesu vicikicchāti.
sn22.84:3.10: rūpe avītarāgassa avītacchandassa avītapemassa avītapipāsassa avītapariḷāhassa avītataṇhassa tassa rūpassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn22.84:5.3: yathātaṃ saṅkhāresu avītarāgassa. viññāṇe avītarāgassa avītacchandassa avītapemassa avītapipāsassa avītapariḷāhassa avītataṇhassa tassa viññāṇassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn22.84:6.5: rūpe vītarāgassa vītacchandassa vītapemassa vītapipāsassa vītapariḷāhassa vītataṇhassa tassa rūpassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn22.84:7.7: viññāṇe vītarāgassa vītacchandassa vītapemassa vītapipāsassa vītapariḷāhassa vītataṇhassa tassa viññāṇassa vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti.
sn22.84:9.2: eko puriso amaggakusalo eko puriso maggakusalo
sn22.84:9.3: tamenaṃ so amaggakusalo puriso amuṃ maggakusalaṃ purisaṃ maggaṃ puccheyya
sn22.84:9.7: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi dvedhāpathaṃ tattha vāmaṃ muñcitvā dakkhiṇaṃ gaṇha
sn22.84:9.9: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi tibbaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ
sn22.84:9.11: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalaṃ
sn22.84:9.13: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi sobbhaṃ papātaṃ
sn22.84:9.15: tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi samaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
sn22.84:10.1: upamā kho myāyaṃ tissa katā atthassa viññāpanāya
sn22.84:10.3: puriso amaggakusaloti kho tissa puthujjanassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn22.84:10.4: puriso maggakusaloti kho tissa tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
sn22.84:10.6: vāmo maggoti kho tissa aṭṭhaṅgikassetaṃ micchāmaggassa adhivacanaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn22.84:10.8: dakkhiṇo maggoti kho tissa ariyassetaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn22.84:10.10: tibbo vanasaṇḍoti kho tissa avijjāyetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn22.84:10.11: mahantaṃ ninnaṃ pallalanti kho tissa kāmānametaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn22.84:10.12: sobbho papātoti kho tissa kodhupāyāsassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn22.84:10.13: samo bhūmibhāgo ramaṇīyoti kho tissa nibbānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn22.84:11.2: attamano āyasmā tisso bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
